name: petal-task-tracker
description: A beautiful task and project tracker with file-based sync

scripts.build: npm run verify:icons && electron-builder --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:mac: npm run verify:icons && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:win: npm run verify:icons && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:all: npm run verify:icons && electron-builder --mac --win --publish never --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run cap:prepare && npx cap sync ios
